about: Voice registry (lib/voice.mjs). Every voice used in a film needs an entry: provider, voiceId, language, dialect, source, rights, commercial (cleared for paid/social delivery?), ownership, consent, quality (draft|good|production). Cloned voices need clone:true + consent {granted, by, date, scope}; the studio refuses them otherwise and never clones a voice from arbitrary footage. Check the provider's current terms before commercial use; entries below record what is known on 2026-10-03.
